data.title: South Africa's Purple Group investigating cybersecurity incident
data.description:
South African financial services company Purple Group on Friday said it is investigating whether personal information was leaked in a cybersecurity incident involving unauthorised access to part of its systems.

Here are some details:

  • The company said the incident was identified on November 25, following which it restricted public access to its investing platform EasyEquities and associated platforms, as a precaution

  • The company said all client funds are accounted for and secure based on the investigation to date

  • EasyEquities and associated platforms will remain offline until the necessary security checks are completed, the firm said

  • The group is investigating the incident with independent specialists, it said

data.title: BitTorrent to Participate in Binance Blockchain Week 2026 in Bangkok on November 28th
data.description:
BitTorrent will participate in Binance Blockchain Week 2026 at QSNCC in Bangkok on November 28th–29th. Its team will meet the community and hold activities at the TRON booth.

Refer to the official tweet by BTT:

BitTorrent
@BitTorrent

BBW 2026 begins tomorrow in Bangkok.

Whether you track BitTorrent through on-chain mechanics like the recent quarterly buyback and burn, rely on software like BitTorrent Classic or Neo, or follow the broader infrastructure integration under the upgraded brand, the ecosystemâ€¦ pic.twitter.com/Bt9eLEd4UM

Nov 27, 2026

BTT Info

BitTorrent (BTTC) is one of the most extensive decentralized P2P file-sharing platforms, operating on the Tron blockchain. The BitTorrent ecosystem includes a platform for live streaming, enabling content creators and viewers to earn and participate in BTTC staking.

The primary mechanism of BitTorrent involves the exchange of files among users rather than storing them on a centralized server. Files and data are distributed among users' computers: when a user downloads a file, they receive its parts from various sources and can subsequently provide the file to other users, becoming a “seed”. Download speed increases directly proportional the number of seeds available for a specific file.

BTTC token is the native token of the TRC-10 standard within the BitTorrent ecosystem and serves as a means of payment for P2P services the BitTorrent network. With it, users can pay for decentralized data storage, participate in file download auctions, receive rewards for providing services, and much more.

data.title: Latvia's airBaltic posts $29 million quarterly loss
data.description:
Latvian airline airBaltic said on Friday its third-quarter net result swung to a loss of €26.6 million ($29.21 million) from a year-ago profit of €6 million, driven by soaring fuel costs.

The carrier, which earlier this year filed for US Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection and is undergoing restructuring, reported a 16.3% rise year-on-year in quarterly revenue while fuel costs rose 55.3%, driven by the war in Iran.

  • Total passengers 3.21 million in July-September vs 2.80 million a year earlier

  • Load factor 82.5% vs 84.6%

  • Adjusted EBITDA €54.0 million vs €65.4 million

  • Throughout the Chapter 11 process, airBaltic continues to operate flights and tickets and bookings remain valid

data.title: Mergers and acquisitions
data.description:
The following bids, mergers, acquisitions and disposals were reported by 1510 GMT on Friday:

** Czech investment group AKIPIA has agreed to acquire leading car locks systems maker Kiekert.

** Deutsche Boerse secured unconditional EU antitrust approval for its €5.35 billion ($5.87 billion) acquisition of fund-trading platform Allfunds after regulators said the deal raised no competition concerns.

** Brazilian energy and commodities company Raizen is considering the sale of its fuel distribution arm as part of a broader divestment plan, founding shareholder Rubens Ometto told Reuters.

** A banking syndicate led by Kazakhstan's largest bank, Halyk , has raised $1.5 billion to fund private investor Central Asia Resources Holding Ltd's acquisition of Kazakh gold miner Altynalmas (ALMS.KZ), Halyk said.

** Offers the Belgian government has received for a 20% stake in state-owned bank Belfius have been too low, Finance Minister Jan Jambon told the parliament.

** Shares of Japan Tobacco jumped on the prospect of the company joining hands with Altria to acquire, and split up, British cigarette maker Imperial Brands in a potential multibillion-dollar deal.

** Tesla has submitted plans to acquire German manufacturing systems supplier EMAG, which also makes parts for humanoid robots, a filing with Germany's antitrust authority showed.

** French laser technology company Lumibird said it had entered into exclusive talks with defence group Thales for the sale of a 51.6% stake held by its CEO and majority shareholder Marc Le Flohic.

** Infrastructure investor I Squared Capital is in advanced talks to buy German outdoor advertising group Stroeer , reviving discussions that stalled earlier this year, according to two people familiar with the matter.

** German automotive and industrial supplier Schaeffler has sold a 6.5% stake in its Indian unit, generating net proceeds of more than €300 million ($330 million), its CEO told Reuters on Thursday.

** Seed group Vilmorin has entered exclusive talks to buy French rival Lidea to strengthen its position in Europe's crop seed market, Vilmorin's parent company said on Thursday.

** Italy's Banco Desio has agreed to buy an 85.3% majority stake in Cassa di Risparmio di Orvieto from Banca del Mezzogiorno for about €124 million ($136 million), the two lenders said in a joint press release on Thursday.
